title: Review the software design to verify compliance with security requirements and risk information
reason: The design of the gate, the deploy and the site is checked against the security requirements and risks in their threat models, and a model turns suspect when its element changes, which is the automated half of PW.2.1. Partial: the models were written by the session that designs the elements and are not yet reviewed by anyone else (no review step, D-055), so they stay written until a review date is recorded.
